dedupe_keys.name: ranplan professional and ranplan in building indoor and outdoor wireless network planning software

description: Ranplan Wireless sells software to design indoor and outdoor wireless networks. Ranplan Professional designs both in one platform and, per the vendor, simulates signal interactions between indoor and outdoor systems in complex environments; Ranplan In-Building targets indoor coverage planning. Version 7.3 adds reusable network designs, multi-building imports and animated 3D coverage views. The site lists uses for private networks, 5G, Wi-Fi, heterogeneous networks with macro and small cells, urban outdoor, tunnels and transport, public safety networks, green networks, smart cities, large venues such as stadiums and airports, IoT and small cells, and publishes guides on connectivity in tunnels and FRMCS rail communications underground. Coverage: generic software. Format and access: licensed software, sold through sales; how it is delivered was not read. Licence: proprietary; terms and prices were not read. Caveats: only the home page was read, so the propagation models, supported building data formats and system requirements were not checked; the productivity claim of 50 per cent is the vendor's. Simulation uses: coverage and capacity planning of in-building, tunnel and public safety radio networks, including resilience of emergency communications. Related records: Forsk Atoll (platform-forsk-atoll) and Remcom Wireless InSite (model-remcom-wireless-insite) are other commercial radio planning and propagation tools.
